# PR #2166: Patch: the glove cursor curls its finger and taps down when it clicks

Closes #2103

## What changed

While a mouse button is held, anything showing the pointing glove now shows a new pressed glove instead; releasing brings the pointing glove back:

- [glove-press.svg](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2103/apps/web/public/cursors/glove-press.svg) (new): the pressed glove, 32×32. It is `glove-point.svg` with the hand shrunk to 0.92 about the fingertip (local point 14.4, 1.6, the top of the finger's arc), the palm/fingers/thumb/cuff moved 2.5 units toward the tip, and a shorter index finger with a knuckle crease. The tip stays on pixel (4, 3), the pointing glove's hotspot.
- [index.css](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2103/apps/web/src/index.css) (the `#1954` fine-pointer block): adds `--cursor-glove-press: url("/cursors/glove-press.svg") 4 3, pointer;` and a `:root:active` rule swapping `--cursor-glove-point` to the press. Custom-property inheritance turns every `var(--cursor-glove-point, pointer)` use into the press while held. Touch and pen are untouched (nothing outside the fine-pointer block names the press); reduced motion needs no override (one still frame, no animation added).
- [cursors.test.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2103/apps/web/src/cursors.test.ts): fourth `GLOVES` entry, `PRESS` constant, `keyframes()` helper, the first test now tolerates exactly the one swap rule, and three new `#2103` tests (swap under fine pointer only, fingertip-is-hotspot, one-still-frame with no keyframed cursor).

No ruling: client CSS/art only, no rules decision (as with #1970). No other stylesheet, SVG, Rust, spec, or e2e file touched.

## How I tested it

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` then `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/cursors.test.ts`: **6/6 passed** (the background chain ran the same pair end-to-end, exit 0).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: clean (an earlier failure was only the not-yet-built `src/wasm/pkg` modules; clean after the build landed).
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/cursors.test.ts`: clean.
- A throwaway node probe (`/tmp/cursors-check.cjs`, not delivered) replayed every new assertion against the real files: all true — `PRESS` once and inside the fine-pointer block, each property set exactly once apart from the swap, only `index.css` naming the press (twice), cursor dir holding exactly the four SVGs, all 276 `@keyframes` blocks closed with none naming `cursor`, no bare `cursor: pointer/grab/grabbing` anywhere.
- `git status` shows only the three intended files; no extra worktrees were created.

## Decisions (issue left open, rejected alternatives)

- **One still press frame**, not a two-frame keyframe tap: `cursor` animates only in discrete flips, browsers differ on redrawing a still mouse's cursor mid-animation, and reduced motion would need its own override.
- **One `:root:active` swap of the custom property**, not an `:active` rule beside each of ~90 uses or a JS pointerdown listener toggling an attribute.
- **Tip fixed, hand shrunk toward it**, not drawn lower in the image: moving the tip would move the hotspot off the fingertip or move where a click lands.
- **No `<link rel="preload">`**: Chrome warns when a preload goes unused right after load, and the other gloves also load on first use.

Reviewers should look twice at the SVG art itself (an 8% shrink, 2.5-unit shorter finger and crease is a judgment call — retunable in `glove-press.svg` keeping the tip at (14.4, 1.6) under the same turn, with the hotspot test's two strings updated to match) and at the known trade-offs from the plan: one whole-page style recalculation per press/release, Firefox skipping the swap where `mousedown` default is prevented, and a possible system-hand flash on the very first press.
